title: Midnight Garden @ Spence Manor| Music Row| Pool
description:
Welcome to Music Row’s Spence Manor, home of world-famous musicians including Elvis Presley, Paul McCartney, and Johnny Cash. Elvis actually leased the entire 6th floor which is our floor! Most artists would stay here when in town to record at nearby studios. This condo was designed to bring back the luxury that these musicians enjoyed. It is at the center of all Nashville entertainment.

The space
Located on Music Row, this space offers the closest proximity to all things Nashville. Our amazing one-bedroom condo is perfect for any couple or small group looking to soak up this vibrant city!

★ Guitar Shaped Pool (May through September)
★ Incredible History
★ Hottest Area in Nashville
★ Safe Neighborhood

Enjoy your stay!
